samples.question: The picture shows blue strips of equal thickness on white paper. Some blue strips are interrupted by white gaps, so the blue ink falls apart into separate pieces. Two black dots sit on blue ink. Two dots count as being on the same piece only if you can travel from one dot to the other while staying on blue ink the whole way, never crossing a white gap and never jumping between strips. Are the two black dots on the same piece of blue ink? Answer yes or no.
